snippet.title: Jump Broke - Official Reveal Trailer | Hardcore Precision Platformer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Jump Broke on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4542730/Jump_Broke/

Meet Jump Broke, a hardcore precision platformer where every single jump literally costs you money.

You play as a mimic chest with no legs. Your only way to move? Firing your own coins at the ground and using the recoil to launch yourself upwards.

Key Features:

Recoil Platforming: No double jumps, no dashes. Just pure, physics-based recoil movement.

High Stakes: 1 Jump = 1 Coin. If you miss a pixel-perfect jump and fall, you will e.

The Ultimate Challenge: You can actually clear the game in massive debt, but beating it with "Zero Debt" is the ultimate honor reserved for platformer gods.

Are you ready to go bankrupt?

📦 Join our Discord community: https://discord.gg/fcSUqcGe
🐦 Follow our devlog on X/Twitter: https://x.com/jiangjacky80

#JumpBroke #IndieGame #PrecisionPlatformer #PixelArt #HardcoreGaming #GameDev
